proposed_capability: Deterministic bottom-right Sims 4 HUD state and intent controller, with collapsed, condensed continuum, expanded maximum, and panel identity independent of internal scroll; host-side pixel evidence for the operator's inventory screenshots; read-only output and safe cooperative-queue handoff, not a model analysis or autonomous desktop clicker.
operator_correction: The operator supplied eight 1919x1079 Live Mode frames plus a ninth close-up of bottom-right navigation. A personal inventory panel is absent in the first, open near minimum in the second and eighth, at maximum in the third, and at intermediate heights in frames four through seven; semantic, geometry and internal scroll must not be conflated. Native event observer has live travel registration proof but no action dispatch proof.
repository_situation: Current ui_microsystems and ui_chrome already own panel identity/hotkeys, screen_atlas owns calibrated input targets, and workflow_interop owns player-first effects; screenshot classification and intent-to-height policy are missing. Skills burger bar has its own measured 1920x1080 drag. Do not duplicate or preempt these owners.

competing_theses.falsification: Repeats interpretation and fails durable host ownership

competing_theses.thesis: Bounded perception-to-semantic-state seam plus goal-driven non-effect transition proposals
competing_theses.falsification: Reject if absent-panel screenshots are misclassified or proposals trigger without fresh independent control gates

selected_thesis: Host-side two-cue inventory panel detector, independent semantic window-height state, and retained existing hotkey/calibration ownership for conservative goal-dependent proposals; unknown modules have UNKNOWN visual state.

p82_experiment_admission.hypothesis: Known-patch inventory screenshots can classify absent/open/max/intermediate without model inference, including near-identical condensed geometry; non-gameplay proposals never claim an executed click.
p82_experiment_admission.baseline: Existing per-panel names and skills-specific drag, without a generic host state observer.
p82_experiment_admission.comparator: Two-cue screen-local inventory detector with normalized expansion ratio and stable no-effect transition planner.
measurements: classification across eight user images and absent panel
all intervening heights map to CONDENSED with ratio
p82_experiment_admission.decision_rule: Promote only source-level detector/policy after offline adversarial tests; P08 stays blocked for live game unless independently run on host.

player_save_control_impact: No gameplay effects, computer input, background hook, saves, spending, or native script integration. Never override an operator-owned panel, selected Sim queue, pause state or explicit game interaction.

expected_outcome: Screenshot-backed semantic inventory state, bounded cached observation and deterministic requested panel-height policy, without image interpretation delegated to an agent.
